title: Physical (electromagnetic) stackup of microphone_array_v2
description: The structure of the four-layer stack, with materials completed from
This file exists because `microphone_array_v2.kicad_pcb` carries no
`(setup (stackup ...))` block at all; the board file states the overall
thickness (1.6 mm) and the copper layer order and nothing else.
The material figures below are NOT typical-FR4 assumptions. The ordered
service (4 layers, 1.6 mm, no impedance control) selects JLCPCB's
documented default construction, and every thickness and epsilon_r is
that construction's own stated figure from the frozen impedance-
calculator evidence, bound by hash in the provenance block. Loss
tangents remain null because the evidence does not state them: an
unevidenced figure would be a guess wearing units, and nothing
downstream could tell it apart from a measured one.
how_to_complete_this_file: Completed 2026-08-28 from the frozen JLCPCB catalog evidence (see
provenance). To revise: only from fabricator stackup documentation
frozen into the approved catalog - never from a datasheet the order
does not establish. Loss tangent still awaits stated evidence.

provenance.evidence: JLCPCB approved catalog (normalized_sha256 f7cd05e75e1f9d6d): construction 'JLC-4L-no-requirement' (excerpt_sha256 822b9999100bea59), the documented DEFAULT for 4-layer boards ordered without impedance control - exactly this board's ordered service (4 layers, 1.6 mm, impedance_control=false in board/jlcpcb_requirements.json). Structurally identical to JLC04161H-7628.
basis: The ordered service is 4 copper layers at 1.6 mm nominal with impedance_control=false; the catalog's stackup records mark JLC-4L-no-requirement as the documented default construction for exactly that order.
Every thickness is the construction's own stated layer figure; every epsilon_r is the frozen materials entry for the construction's own named material; nothing is a typical-FR4 assumption.

Copper layers carry TWO figures on purpose: thickness_mm is the construction's stated layer height (base foil - the vertical-geometry quantity), and finished_thickness_mm is the catalog's finished-conductor figure, plating included (the conductor-model quantity: trace resistance and thickness-corrected transmission-line models). External 1 oz plates from 35 um foil to 1.6 mil = 40.64 um finished (record finished_copper_external_1oz_mil); internal 0.5 oz does not plate and stays 0.6 mil = 15.24 um (record finished_copper_internal_0.5oz_mil). The two numbers are never interchangeable, and every derived geometry records which one it used.
Loss tangents remain null: the frozen evidence does not state them, and an unevidenced figure would be exactly the guessed-Dk failure this file's description warns about, one field over.

notes: Structure declared by the board; materials completed from the frozen JLCPCB catalog evidence (see provenance).
Overall board thickness comes from the board file's (general (thickness)) and is not restated here.
